title: Ticket Trends
description: Ticket volume, domain/priority mix, and rolling escalation rate from fact_ticket_events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, COUNT(*) AS tickets
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, COALESCE(domain_pack, 'unknown') AS domain_pack, COUNT(*) AS tickets
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time, domain_pack
ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, COALESCE(priority, 'unknown') AS priority, COUNT(*) AS tickets
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time, priority
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 7-Day Rolling Escalation Rate
panels.description: Rolling window so a real upward trend is visible before a single bad day would show it -- pair with an alert rule on this panel to catch a rising escalation rate early.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS day,
    COUNTIF(final_action = 'escalate') AS escalated,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT day AS time,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(escalated) OVER (ORDER BY UNIX_DATE(DATE(day)) RANGE BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
    SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY UNIX_DATE(DATE(day)) RANGE BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
  ) AS rolling_7d_escalation_rate
FROM daily
ORDER BY day
